description_en: Queries the monitoring data of a specified product instance within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询一段时间内指定产品实例的监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms query-metric-list --callby-cms-owner urs879e --project acs_ecs_dashboard --metric cpu_idle --period 60 --start-time 2019-01-30_00:00:00 --end-time 2019-01-30_00:10:00 --dimensions instanceId_:_i-abcdefgh123456 --page 1 --cursor v2. --length 1000 --express groupby_:_instanceId --api-version 2017-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMetricList

parameters.help_en: The namespace that indicates the product to which the monitoring data belongs, such as "acs_ecs_dashboard" and "acs_rds_dashboard"
parameters.help_zh: 名字空间，表明监控数据所属产品，如 “acs_ecs_dashboard”,“acs_rds_dashboard”等
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The time interval. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 60, 300, and 900
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The start time. You can specify the value as the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00, January 1, 1970, or as a formatted time string such as 2015-10-20 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间,可以传入距离1970年1月1日0点的毫秒数，也可以传入format时间格式数据，如2015-10-20 00:00:00。
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. You can specify the value as the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00, January 1, 1970, or as a formatted time string such as 2015-10-20 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 可以传入距离1970年1月1日 0点的毫秒数，也可以传入format时间格式数据，如2015-10-20 00:00:00。
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring dimensions of the specified resource.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs. Example: `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`.

A maximum of 50 instances can be queried in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
指定资源的监控维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：`{"userId":"120886317861****"}`和`{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`。

单次请求最多支持批量查询50个实例
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en: The cursor for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 下一页数据，为空代表没有下一页
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. This parameter is used for paging
parameters.help_zh: 每次查询大小，用于分页查询
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en: The expression for real-time computation on existing query results. Currently, only groupby is supported, which is similar to the GROUP BY statement in databases
parameters.help_zh: 对查询出的现有结果进行实时计算的表达式。目前仅支持groupby，类似数据库的groupby语句
parameters.name: express
